name: ROCKS [ALPHA]
desc:
[😎] rock game? rock people? rock pets? no way!

[🪨] Stack rocks on your head, throw them, sell them, and use your money to level up your character and explore new, diverse, and exciting areas!

[👍] Remember to like the game, it helps a lot!
[💸] Use code: "fiveBigOnes" for an extra 5,000 Money at the start of the game!
[☁️!Update 22!☁️] Use code: "veryhungry" for a 10 minute potion effect!

[💫] Join the group for updates on new codes and features!

[🐛] Game is in development, if you encounter any bugs, send a message to the group owner.
